Cherry Tomato & Spinach Scrambled Eggs 
Boost your protein | Easy breakfast | Satisfying brunch | One-pan wonder

SAVE this recipe to make soon and FOLLOW @ellasrecipebook_ for more :) 

Nutrition: 
C: 11  F: 10 | P: 17
Calories: 196 per serve without bread / cheese 
Serves 1

Ingredients 
2 sprays of olive oil
1 tsp minced garlic 
6 cherry tomatoes, halved
handful of spinach, chopped
2 eggs + 1 tbsp milk ( optional ) 
salt + pepper to taste ( i prefer a generous amount of black pe ) 

optional: 20 grams of feta / cheddar on top 

to serve: as is or with toast
